	t.Helper()

extensions: [".py"]

  unit_end: dedent
  actions:
    def: setThing
",

    kwargs:

      name: { type: string, required: true }
      code: { type: string, required: true }
    injects_into: "{{file}}"
    anchor: decls
",
		filepath.Join(gen, "py", "actions", "setThing.py"):  "{{code}}
",
		filepath.Join(prov, "imp.yml"):                      "id: prov-2026-aaaaaaaa
type: imprint
status: open
intent: adopt py files
created_at: "2026-10-16"
affected_scope: ["*.py"]
",
		filepath.Join(proj, "a.py"):                         "def f():
    return 1
",
		filepath.Join(proj, "b.py"):                         "import os

def g():
    return 1
",
	}
	for path, content := range files {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	return gen, prov, proj
